### Planning Intelligence Log

- Web research (Step 2): not triggered — sufficient context from in-repo investigation (Explore agent over phase-state sources, sibling override infra, PreToolUse hook contract, the 66 HARD-GATEs) plus a feasibility spike; no external library/API decision.
- Feasibility resolution: triggered and PASSED — a throwaway PreToolUse-hook spike experimentally verified all three seed gates: repo-vs-temp realpath classification + block/allow/fail-open-observable (Gate 1), git status + git worktree enumeration with session-id-encoded branch names (Gate 2), and the test-gate RED-zone reuse (.test-index [first_red_test_name] + test-gate-status failed_tests) for Gate 3.
- Scenario analysis (Step 3): triggered (SCs >= 5); 13 red-team scenarios surfaced. Critical/important folded into the spec: fix-bug RED-signal timing (signal now established by running the RED test at Phase E Step 1, not assumed from commit-time); behavioral-bug exemption requires a positive recorded classification (absence is not a bypass); session-collision (markers session-partitioned by session_id); override self-grant; temp-then-move evasion (Gate 1 also gates Bash move/patch into the repo tree). Moderate residuals (jq/realpath availability, BSD-vs-GNU realpath, cross-platform) recorded as considerations / Out-of-Scope.
- Fidelity review (Step 4): Agent Clarity 3 -> revised (named canonical session_id source, TTL config key, heartbeat trigger, registry/format pointers); Scope 4 (pass; SC6 demoted to Closure Check, SC4 brainstorm-scope documented); Value 3 -> revised (dropped implementation-plan instrumentation per YAGNI, added shadow/log-only baseline mode). One revision cycle (REVISION_CYCLES=1).
- Prompt alignment (Step 5): triggered (LLM-instruction signal — epic modifies agent control surfaces: a blocking PreToolUse hook, a non-self-grantable override, a brainstorm gate-classification step). bot-psychologist returned 6 risks; folded: override must require an explicit current-turn user instruction (not mere interactive presence); growth step uses a neutral fixed template with no nudge-to-decline + declines logged; fail-open distinguishes indeterminate-at-start vs went-stale and rate-limits warnings; block messages carry ordered remediation; behavioral-bug exemption hardened.
- Architectural probe (class:architectural): run — scaffold produced; gate satisfied.
- Cross-epic scan (Step 2.25): focused scan over af26's relates_to set (3c01, 7510, 9778, 99f1, ab57) + sibling-infra epics d076/750c. Both d076 and 750c are CLOSED; investigation found the reusable override/audit + session-state-aware hook-installation infra already shipped independently, so the stub's HARD block on d076 was downgraded to relates_to. No new conflicts surfaced.
- Scale context (Step 0): not applicable — developer-tooling; no record/traffic axis.
- Complexity routing signal: success_criteria_count = 5 (plus State Lifecycle + Closure Checks) — would route to full /dso:preplanning.
- User-directed design decisions: seed-and-grow (3 seed gates); brainstorm-confirmed growth; fail-open + observable; self-use dogfood; keep all 3 gates with Gate 3 reusing the test-gate RED mechanism; Gate 1 repo-only (temp allowed); Gate 2 session-scoped harvest/commit; Option A per-skill session-partitioned phase markers with TTL/heartbeat/owned-RETIRE staleness defenses.
- Provenance note: prior 2026-05-18 tag-integrity correction removed a mis-applied brainstorm:complete (stub). This pass ran the full canonical scrutiny pipeline, so the tag is now legitimately applied. Bug 01b9-3359-7df3-45cf filed for the non-idempotent migration that resurrected the stale tag.
